facts.fact: Parque das Aves is next to Iguaçu National Park, where Iguaçu Falls is located. Therefore, it is possible to visit Iguaçu Falls and Parque das Aves on the same day! We recommend visiting Parque das Aves first, having lunch with us (see our menu), and then heading to the Falls.
facts.location: Visible source text, paragraph containing: Parque das Aves is next to Iguaçu National Park

facts.fact: Parque das Aves operates normally on rainy days. Many birds even enjoy the rain, especially on hot days, and put on a show. Others tend to stay more sheltered, especially on cold days. The vegetation looks beautiful, and visitors usually wear rain ponchos or take the opportunity to have an even more immersive connection with nature.
